notes.title: ESCAPE FROM VOYNA: REMASTER
notes.content:
Good day
We would like to inform you that we are working on revising EFY and making it available to all of you as a remaster. 

It will probably come out in 2021!

notes.title: Patch is out now
notes.content:
-Fix Sound Problems
-FIx Buttons
-Weapon sounds have been adjusted!
-The "EXIT THE GAME" button has been replaced by the "MAIN MENU" button. It is now possible to return to the main menu during the game.
-Ai wayfinding improved

notes.title: Dear customers
notes.content:
Dear customers

The team
